The solid is an **oblique cone**. 

Notice the following:

- The solid has one circular base and one vertex. So, it's a cone.

- The axis that passes through the center of the circle and the vertex is not perpendicular to the base. So, it's oblique, not right.
html:
The solid is an oblique cone.

Notice the following:

  • The solid has one circular base and one vertex. So, it's a cone.

  • The axis that passes through the center of the circle and the vertex is not perpendicular to the base. So, it's oblique, not right.
